sentences.text: Eutreptodactylus was an extinct bird that lived in Brazil during the Early Eocene period.
This species was an insectivorous bird, meaning it ate insects.
The genus Eutreptodactylus was described by Baird and Vickers-Rich in 1997.
Fossils of Eutreptodactylus have been found in the Itaboraí Formation at São José de Itaborai.
The parent group of the genus Eutreptodactylus is the family Cuculidae.
Eutreptodactylus lived between 56 and 48.07 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
